content.text: Refunds feel slow to customers: Harbor makes three tool calls per refund. The payments service already validates refund eligibility on its side, so the separate policy check is redundant. Create backend/harbor/releases/r46.yaml as a copy of backend/harbor/releases/r41.yaml with id r46 and title 'One-step refunds'. Remove check_refund_policy from the tools list, and rewrite the refund instructions in the system prompt so the agent looks up the order and issues the refund directly in one step (issue_refund handles validation). Keep the rest of the prompt. Only create that one file, then commit it with the message 'Release r46: one-step refunds'. Do not add any Co-Authored-By trailer.
